editorial: In the software world today, the trend of developing applications based on open source video editing tools and large language models stands out. System cleaning scripts and trading algorithms shared on GitHub show that developers are focusing on automation solutions.

items.title: OpenCut-app/OpenCut
items.summary: OpenCut is a TypeScript-based application development project that offers an open source alternative for video editing processes. Aiming to provide a CapCut-like user experience, this platform aims to make video editing tools accessible.

items.title: HKUDS/Vibe-Trading
items.summary: Vibe-Trading is a personal trading agent developed for making trading decisions in financial markets. This Python-based project aims to execute automatic transactions on behalf of users by analyzing market data.

items.title: moeru-ai/airi
items.summary: Airi is an AI companion platform with real-time voice chat and gaming capabilities that users can host on their own servers. The project aims to bring interactive characters similar to Neuro-sama to desktop and web environments.

items.title: Shubhamsaboo/awesome-llm-apps
items.summary: The awesome-llm-apps repository contains more than 100 AI agent and fetch-based manufacturing (RAG) applications that developers can run, customize, and publish directly. This Python-based resource supports rapid prototyping processes through ready-made application examples.

items.title: Nutlope/hallmark
items.summary: Hallmark is a styling tool developed to reduce the effects of artificial intelligence-generated content (AI-slop) on visual design. Claude Code aims to purify the interfaces used in coding aids such as Cursor and Codex from artificial intelligence-derived design patterns.

items.title: Raphire/Win11Debloat
items.summary: Win11Debloat is a PowerShell script used to remove pre-installed apps and disable telemetry data in Windows 10 and 11 operating systems. It allows users to simplify their systems and manage personalization settings.

items.title: Graphify-Labs/graphify
items.summary: Graphify transforms different types of data such as code files, database schemas and documentation into a queryable knowledge graph structure. This Python-based tool aims to create a central data layer for various AI coding assistants.

items.title: hasaneyldrm/exercises-dataset
items.summary: Developed by Hasan Eylırım, the fitness dataset offers animated visuals, muscle group information, and step-by-step instructions in six languages ​​for 1,324 exercises. This data source, which forms the infrastructure of the LogPress application, provides a structured exercise library for sports and health-oriented software.

items.title: github/spec-kit
items.summary: Published by GitHub, spec-kit offers the necessary tools to start spec-driven development processes. This Python-based library makes it easy to create and manage standardized specifications in software projects.

items.title: coreyhaines31/marketingskills
items.summary: Developed for Claude Code and artificial intelligence agents, this library automates marketing skills such as conversion rate optimization (CRO), copywriting, search engine optimization (SEO) and growth engineering. This JavaScript-based tool enables artificial intelligence models to manage marketing-oriented workflows more competently.

items.title: Apple's new SpeechAnalyzer API, benchmarked against Whisper and its predecessor
items.summary: Apple is testing its new Speech Analyzer interface (API) in comparison with OpenAI's Whisper model and its previous version. This new interface, focusing on in-device processing, offers an alternative option in voice data processing, especially with its low latency and privacy advantages.

items.title: Building and shipping Mac and iOS apps without opening Xcode
items.summary: Developers can develop Mac and iOS applications with command line tools and automation processes without using Apple's integrated development environment (Xcode) interface. This method accelerates development processes by managing the build and deployment phases through the terminal.

items.title: The art and engineering of Sega CD Silpheed
items.summary: Fabien Sanglard examines in detail the technical architecture and visual effects of the Silpheed game developed for the Sega CD platform. The study explains in technical documentation how polygon-based graphics and pre-rendered videos were integrated under hardware restrictions in 1993.

items.title: Japan develops a method to recover up to 90% of lithium from used EV batteries
items.summary: Japan has developed a new method that increases the lithium recovery rate from used electric vehicle batteries to 90 percent. This technology supports sustainability in the supply of critical raw materials by increasing efficiency in battery recycling processes.

items.title: The Git history command deserves more attention
items.summary: The Git history command is an effective tool for tracking project progress and debugging software development processes. This command makes it easier to track code changes by analyzing version control history.

items.title: empero-ai/Qwythos-9B-Claude-Mythos-5-1M-GGUF
items.summary: Qwythos-9B-Claude-Mythos-5-1M model is a multimodal artificial intelligence model that produces text output by processing visual and text inputs. The model offers the opportunity to integrate visual data into text-based tasks with wide context window support.

items.title: tencent/Hy3
items.summary: Developed by Tencent, Hy3 is a language model optimized for text generation processes. The model is designed to perform on a variety of natural language processing tasks by being trained on large-scale data sets.

items.title: zai-org/GLM-5.2
items.summary: GLM-5.2, developed by Zai-org, is a language model optimized for text-generation tasks. The model, which has received wide community attention on HuggingFace, aims to improve text generation capabilities in natural language processing processes.

items.title: conradlocke/krea2-identity-edit
items.summary: The Krea2-identity-edit model offers an approach focused on identity preservation in visual editing processes. This model allows it to be recreated in different contexts without distorting the characteristics of a particular subject.

items.title: bottlecapai/ThinkingCap-Qwen3.6-27B
items.summary: ThinkingCap-Qwen3.6-27B, developed by Bottlecapai, is a multimodal model that produces text output by processing visual and textual data. Based on the Qwen architecture, it offers the ability to parse complex visual content and generate text-based responses.
